ir.name: usw_source_length_normalized_jssp50x20
ir.intuition: Preserve the discovered USW loss while expressing its total log-probability difference at the 100-decision JSSP10x10 source trajectory scale.
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw_mean = batch['log_prob_w_mean']
    lpl_mean = batch['log_prob_l_mean']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    source_steps = 100.0
    abs_adv = ops.abs(advantage_gap)
    mean_abs_adv = ops.mean(abs_adv)
    norm_adv = ops.maximum(mean_abs_adv, epsilon)
    source_diff = ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw_mean, lpl_mean), source_steps)
    diff = ops.div(source_diff, norm_adv)
    sigmoid_diff = ops.sigmoid(diff)
    loss = ops.neg(ops.log(sigmoid_diff))
    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    loss_sum = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight)
    return ops.div(loss_sum, ops.maximum(weight_sum, epsilon))
